instruction: Send the following phone message to my siblings and roommates, who do not have a venmo account, "Get on venmo please!".
notes: Contacts are placeholders: sibling-1 and roommate-1 stand for siblings/roommates whose venmo.show_profile returns 'Account for this email does not exist.' (modeled by the static fact no-venmo-account), sibling-2 stands for a sibling who already has a Venmo account (checked but never messaged). At runtime the agent instantiates one placeholder per real contact found. The placeholders and the message text are domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can state the exact goal without parameters. phone-search-contacts is parameterized per discovered contact (effects known-phone/known-email); the two sibling searches are the same runtime call (relationship=siblings, all pages), whose results are reused. venmo-show-profile asserts venmo-status-known; phone-send-text-message additionally requires no-venmo-account, so messages go to exactly the contacts without Venmo. Logins require supervisor.show_profile (usernames: phone number for phone, email for venmo) and supervisor.show_account_passwords; token-for ties each token object to its app. Venmo is logged in once rather than once per contact. The optional query parameter of search_contacts is omitted (relationship suffices). complete_task takes no answer.
